## holt 0.4.2 — stable release proof runner repair

Install the signed, version-pinned GitHub release artifact:

```bash
npm install -g https://github.com/Raed2180416/holt/releases/download/v0.4.2/holt.tgz
```

The bare `holt` npm registry name is not an official distribution. Do not use
`npm install -g holt`; use the exact GitHub release URL.

This patch keeps the 0.4.1 product bytes and makes the stable-tag quality lane self-contained by
installing its pinned Rust toolchain before building the measured Jujutsu backend. It is not
evidence of customer adoption, productivity gains, universal host enforcement, or a commercial
service.

### Verify this exact artifact

After downloading `holt.tgz` and the release assets:

```bash
gh release verify v0.4.2 --repo Raed2180416/holt
gh release verify-asset v0.4.2 holt.tgz --repo Raed2180416/holt
gh attestation verify holt.tgz --repo Raed2180416/holt
holt audit --require-signature
```

Each command verifies a different boundary. Do not infer provenance if the attestation query does
not succeed.

For the full change ledger and remaining gaps, see the
[post-v0.3.1 55-commit audit](https://github.com/Raed2180416/holt/blob/v0.4.2/docs/research/2026-08-13-post-v0.3.1-55-commit-audit.md).
